info.title: sloc
info.description: A .NET global CLI tool that counts code, comment, and blank lines across source files. Supports 44 languages with auto-detection, five output formats (table, JSON, HTML, CSV, Markdown), per-file detail view, and comment health indicators.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Sloc - counts code, comment, and blank lines in source files.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information.

options.name: --list-file
options.description: Analyze exactly the files listed (one path per line) in this file instead of scanning a directory. Use '-' to read the list from stdin. Ignores 'path'.

options.name: --include
options.description: Glob pattern of files to include. Can be specified multiple times.

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Glob pattern of files to exclude. Can be specified multiple times.

options.name: --exclude-dir
options.description: Directory name to exclude at any depth (e.g. "vendor"). Shorthand for --exclude "**/<name>/**". Can be specified multiple times.

options.name: --include-lang
options.description: Language name to include, matched case-insensitively. Can be specified multiple times. Supported: Assembly, BASIC, Batch, C#, C/C++, Clojure, CMake, CSS, Dart, Dockerfile, Elixir, F#, Go, Groovy, Haskell, HTML, INI, Java, JavaScript, JSON, Julia, Jupyter Notebook, Kotlin, Lua, Makefile, Markdown, Objective-C, Pascal, Perl, PHP, PowerShell, Protobuf, Python, R, Ruby, Rust, Scala, SCSS/Less, Shell, SQL, Svelte, Swift, Terraform, TOML, TypeScript, Visual Basic, Vue, XML, YAML.

options.name: --exclude-lang
options.description: Language name to exclude, matched case-insensitively. Can be specified multiple times. Supported: Assembly, BASIC, Batch, C#, C/C++, Clojure, CMake, CSS, Dart, Dockerfile, Elixir, F#, Go, Groovy, Haskell, HTML, INI, Java, JavaScript, JSON, Julia, Jupyter Notebook, Kotlin, Lua, Makefile, Markdown, Objective-C, Pascal, Perl, PHP, PowerShell, Protobuf, Python, R, Ruby, Rust, Scala, SCSS/Less, Shell, SQL, Svelte, Swift, Terraform, TOML, TypeScript, Visual Basic, Vue, XML, YAML.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: Table, Json, Html, Csv, or Markdown. Inferred from the --output extension when omitted.

options.name: --no-recursive
options.description: Do not descend into subdirectories. [default: False]

options.name: --by-file
options.description: Show a per-file breakdown in addition to the language summary. [default: False]

options.name: --detailed
options.description: In Json, Html, and Markdown output, include both the language summary and the per-file breakdown. In Csv output, selects the language summary only. [default: False]

options.name: --paged
options.description: Enable pagination when displaying the per-file breakdown. [default: False]

options.name: --all
options.description: Include files whose extension maps to no known language. [default: False]

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file path for Json and Html formats. Use '-' to write to stdout.

options.name: --no-health
options.description: Hide the Comment Health column and percentage breakdowns. [default: False]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress the banner, progress UI, and 'Saved to' message. [default: False]

options.name: --no-progress
options.description: Suppress the live table and progress bar. [default: False]

options.name: --min-comment-pct
options.description: Fail (exit code 2) if the overall comment percentage is below this value.

options.name: --jobs
options.description: Maximum number of files to analyze in parallel. Defaults to the processor count; use 1 for sequential.

options.name: --no-gitignore
options.description: Do not honor .gitignore files (they are respected by default). [default: False]

options.name: --follow-symlinks
options.description: Descend into symlinked/junctioned directories instead of skipping them. A symlink that loops directly back to one of its own ancestors is still skipped. [default: False]

options.name: --baseline
options.description: Compare against a previously saved JSON report and show the line-count diff.

options.name: --sort
options.description: Order the language summary by: Total (default), Code, Comment, Blank, Files, or Name.

options.name: --top
options.description: Show only the top N languages in the summary.

options.name: --no-update-check
options.description: Do not check GitHub for a newer release (checked by default, with a 2 second timeout). [default: False]

options.name: --unique
options.description: Count each distinct file content only once; later byte-identical duplicates are reported as skipped. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: The file or directory to analyze. [default: .]
